contexts.text: It was therefore commanded in the Representative Church that...
As, in the Representative Churches...
The idolatry from which came the Representative Church. Signified, Explained. AC 1361.
This Representative Church was instituted, after all internal worship had perished... in order that there might be some conjunction of Heaven with earth...
That those in idolatrous worship were instructed... in order that a Representative Church might come forth. Signified.
The beginning of a Representative Church through Abram. Signified. AC 1409:2.

For a Representative Church had been instituted in Canaan, in which each and all things represented the Lord, and the celestial and spiritual things of His Kingdom; not only the rites, but also all things which were adjoined to the rites; both those who ministered, and the things by which they ministered, and also the places where the ministration took place. Because there was a Representative Church there, that Land was called the Holy Land...
In order that a Representative Church might be instituted with (the descendants of Jacob).
The Last Judgment of the Representative Church... was when the ten tribes were carried away into captivity...
Preface. 3. In the Jewish and Israelitish Representative Church...
Therefore a Representative Church was instituted in that nation. Explained. AC 3480, Explained.
That through (the descendants of Abraham) a Representative Church might be instituted, in which nothing is reflected upon the person, or places, but upon the Thing represented. AC 4112:2.
In order that a Representative Church might come forth, and thus some communication of the Lord with man, they had to be kept especially in the acknowledgement of Jehovah...
Sacrifices and burnt - offerings were the principal things of all the worship of the subsequent Representative Church, that is, the Hebrew one...
The Church instituted with them was not a Church, but only the representative of a Church, and therefore that Church is called a Representative Church.

It is to be known what a Representative Church is, and what the Representative of a Church. There is a Representative Church when there is internal worship in the external; but the Representative of a Church when there is no internal worship, but still external. There are in both almost the like external rituals... but in a Representative Church the externals correspond to the internals, so that they make a one, whereas in the Representative of a Church there is no correspondence, because the externals are either devoid of internals, or disagree with them. In a Representative Church celestial and spiritual love is the principal thing; but in the Representative of a Church corporeal and worldly love... The Ancient Church was a Representative Church; but that instituted with the descendants of Jacob was only the Representative of a Church. (Examples of the worship in a Representative Church, enumerated and ex., and how in the Representative of a Church they became idolatrous.) AC 4425.

In general, those of the Representative Church communicated with the three Heavens as to their interiors, for which the externals served as a plane; whereas those in the Representative of a Church did not communicate with the Heavens as to their interiors, but still the externals in which they were kept could serve as a plane (for such communication).
(The Israelites) lost all the worship of the Representative Church...
Hence arose the Representative Church.
The Christian Church, in its essence, is the same as to the internal form as the Representative Church; but the representatives, etc. of that Church have been abrogated...
The Ancient Church... was a Representative Church. Explained. AC 4844:4. AC 9391:8, Explained. AC 10177:10.
Tamar = a Church Representative of spiritual and celestial things... (See AC 4844. AC 4846.) AC 4856. AC 4866.
A Representative Church, such as was with the Ancients, was to have been instituted with the (Israelites)...
The Jews regarded the internal truths of the Representative Church no otherwise than as a harlot. Signified.
That a Representative Church could not be instituted with that nation. Signified, Explained. AC 7048.
Zipporah = a Representative Church. Explained.
(The Representative Church among the Egyptians: its fall described.)
In the Representative Church the Sabbath was most holy...
A Representative Church was instituted with the Israelitish nation, that is, a Church, in which internal things... were represented by external ones...
What a Representative Church is, and why it [existed]. Explained.
The sons of Israel, here, = the Representative Church. Explained.
The presence of the Lord in the Representative Church. Signified, Explained.
The worship of the Representative Church. Signified, Explained.
The laws of order in the Representative Church. Signified, Explained.
The influx and presence of the Lord in the worship of the Representative Church. Signified, Explained.
This (Representative) Church was instituted in Canaan especially on account of the Word...
The Representative Church which was to be instaurated with those in the good of love and good of faith. Treated of.
Hence that (Ancient) Church was called a Representative Church.
Whence the Churches of that time were called Representative Churches.
All the Churches before His advent were Representative Churches; and therefore they could not see Divine truth except in the shade... DLW 233:2. TCR 109.
That a Representative Church is the body of the Church.
Hence the Church (of the Israelites) is called a Representative Church.
The Church with (the Ancients in Canaan, Syria, Assyria, Arabia, Ethiopia, Egypt, Chaldea, Tyre, Sidon, and elsewhere) was a Representative Church. Explained.
But still there was with (the Israelites) also a Representative Church...

All the Churches up to the Lord's advent were Representative Churches: they represented the Church, and, in the supreme sense, the Lord... But the Representative Churches ceased when the Lord came... There were three remarkable changes of the Representative Churches: the first, before the Flood... the second, after the Flood... and the third, the Israelitish...
How the Representative Church with (the Ancients) was turned into idolatry. Explained.
On this account... a new Representative Church was raised up with the sons of Israel, in which real representations were instituted...
